headline: An ultra-light kick scooter designed to go wherever you go.

idea.heading: The Idea
idea.body:
How far can a kick scooter be reduced while remaining fully functional?

TaschenRoller explores the minimum components and dimensions needed for a rideable scooter — with the goal of creating a vehicle light and compact enough to be carried whenever it is not in use.

problem.heading: The Problem
problem.body: Public transport efficiently covers longer distances, but the first and last mile often remains inconvenient. Kick scooters can bridge this gap, yet conventional models become bulky objects that have to be carried, stored or left behind once the ride is over.
